source: B CISA2020 Fig1b two-core window detector, 55nm schematic TT27C1.2V
voltage_mapping: V=raw/160; ADC inverse RNE(raw*255/192); raw above192 not clipped before mapping
held_model: deterministic bilinear CM/signed-d interpolation of baseline-subtracted HADC_P; outside grid clamp to edge and count; no fitted random distribution
state: P=current fresh sample, N=previous active sample held at prior985ps; prior returned code feeds prefix; N residual discarded after old sample already digitized; state extension beyond B test history assumed
decision: input-referred19/38mV step approximation; guard sweeps constrain intervals, not precise transition. Do not add HCAP error again to this decision
rail_policy: if either SA input outside0..1.2V, bypass detector and use full native ADC; explicit software completion assumption
fit_data: only B schematic data; no workload labels used
caveats: large-d residual extrapolation and arbitrary history not characterized
no PVT,MC,PEX or extra Gaussian noise
0..1.2V raw full-scale mapping assumed; native digital transfer unchanged
